profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a credit bureau based in Atlanta, Georgia, and its site offers credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers. The company also markets identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product it calls Equifax Complete, and says its ID Restoration Specialists work on behalf of customers who become victims of identity theft. Its site also publishes educational material on credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, and fraud, with some content in Spanish.

Equifax is a public company traded under the ticker EFX and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000033185. The site's own framing centers on monitoring a person's Equifax credit report, sending alerts, and helping customers recover from identity theft.

The available record does not list any AI products, MCP servers, or lawsuits for the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Georgia, with a count of 105.
